name: AI storage rack (10 x DDN AI400X3M class appliances)
description: Air-cooled 600 mm 42U rack of ten 2U all-NVMe parallel file system appliances (DDN AI400X3M basis: 24 NVMe drives, 4 x XDR/400GbE OSFP host ports, up to 190 GB/s read each). Similar density to VAST/WEKA reference racks. Values are typical estimates to override per design.

nominal_power_w.note: 10 appliances at ~2.0 kW typical (DDN cites a 2400 W 2U AI400X3 appliance; typical taken ~85%) plus ~0.2 kW management switch

peak_power_w.note: press release: 10 x 2400 W per 2U appliance, plus management; not a datasheet value

power_shelves.note: no 54 V power shelves; appliances use 2 x C20 AC PSUs on rack PDUs

max_coolant_supply_c.note: not applicable: air-cooled rack, no coolant loop

rack_pressure_drop_kpa.note: not applicable: air-cooled rack, no coolant loop

depth_mm.note: typical deep cabinet for 2U storage appliances

weight_kg.note: 10 x 49 kg max appliance weight (AI400X3M spec table, press) + ~150 kg cabinet + ~60 kg PDUs/cables/switch

scale_out_ports.note: 10 appliances x 4 XDR/400GbE OSFP host ports (AI400X3M spec table, press report)

port_speed_gbps.note: XDR InfiniBand 800 Gb/s option; Ethernet option is 400GbE (override to 400 for Ethernet storage fabrics)

switch_slots.note: 1U out-of-band management switch; storage fabric leaves sit in network racks

sources.title: StorageReview: DDN launches AI400X3M (ISC 2026), spec table
DDN press release: AI400X3 record-breaking performance density (2400 W 2U appliance)
